name: com.nexus.ads.bridge.nexus
description: Puts the com.nexus.ads controller behind com.nexus.core's AdService as its IAdNetworkAdapter (with the outcome, readiness and consent capabilities), wires the ad-free entitlement to IapService, forwards revenue to AdService.RaiseImpression, and optionally reads the kill switch and pacing from com.nexus.firebase's remote configuration. Game code written against IAdService does not change.
